messages.author: 1e0668bd9a9e4212
messages.subject: Effect of adjusting toler argument
parts:
Dear GenomicSEM users,

Recently I encountered the following error when trying to run userGWAS function: 

Error in .userGWAS_main(i, int, n_phenotypes, n, I_LD, V_LD, S_LD, std.lv,  : task 339 failed - "system is computationally singular: reciprocal condition number = 5.62885e-32"           Calls: userGWAS -> %dopar% -> <Anonymous>

Based on the provided suggestions in this group I set the toler argument to a lower value:  toler=1e-80, which allowed usergwas to finalize. However, I wanted to ask how adjusting the tolerance may affect the results of usergwas?  

Thank you very much in advance!

messages.author: ac421cf36d1a4c37
messages.subject: Re: Effect of adjusting toler argument
parts: lowering the tolerance value simply makes the calculations more precise, which is particularly important when values are very small.
